We sell to distributors that sell to resellers and to service providers and managed security service providers (“MSSPs”), who, in turn, sell products and/or services to end-customers.
Our integrated platform, the Fortinet Security Fabric, spans secure networking, unified Secure Access Service Edge (“SASE”) and artificial intelligence (“AI”)-driven security operations (“SecOps”).
FortiExtender secures 5G/LTE and remote ethernet extenders to connect and secure any branch environment.

FortiAI-Protect utilizes AI/Machine Learnings (“ML”) to address AI-driven threats and zero-day attacks, and support governance over generative AI (“GenAI”) applications, FortiAI-SecureAI focus on protecting an organization’s AI infrastructure, including large language models (“LLMs”) and Application Programming Interface (“APIs”), and preventing data leakage into and out of LLMs.

Within AI for Security, FortiAI-Assist uses generative and agentic AI to support Network Operations Center (“NOC”) and Security Operations Center (“SOC”) teams in monitoring, analysis and response activities across enterprise environments.

As of December 31, 2025, our end-customers were located in over 100 countries and included enterprises across a wide variety of market verticals, including financial services, retail, healthcare and operational technology (“OT”) market verticals, communication and security service providers, and government organizations.

audit_notes_zh_tw: 2025 年 10-K 直接列名製造、ASIC、晶片、記憶體及分銷商，且 87% 硬體在台灣製造。
IHG 4,000 據點屬全球部署計畫規模，非全部完工量。
MPS 是 Fortinet 與 Arista 2025-12-17 具名已部署的 AI 資料中心方案客戶。
Microsoft 既為 Azure 技術整合平台，亦列於 Fortinet 10-K 競爭者清單。
通路及供應鏈受惠連結僅表示有直接交易關係或商機，不推定量化營收增長。
競爭者替換為 10-K 直接具名 Netskope 與 F5 Networks，避免使用 10-K 未具名的對象作為該來源直接證據。
